issues.description: default_raise() sentinel and '< 3.10 compatibility' comments remain after the precondition was removed.
issues.detail: wallet_request_types.py still defines default_raise() with the comment 'just for < 3.10 compatibility' and uses field(default_factory=default_raise) across request types. With 3.10 as the floor and kw_only universally available, this is dead scaffolding whose rationale no longer holds. Either delete the sentinel and make these required kw_only fields, or update the rationale.

issues.description: Ruff UP007/UP035/UP045 globally ignored with a bare TODO contradicts the PR's stated Union/Optional modernization.
issues.detail: The PR description promises Union -> | and Optional -> | None migration, but ruff.toml disables exactly those rules with only a TODO comment. There is no tracking issue, scope, or kill-date. Either land the codemod in this PR or stage it with a referenced tracking issue; do not ship the intent decoupled from enforcement.

issues.description: install.sh version guard still permits 3.7-3.9 while the error message and pyproject require >= 3.10.
issues.detail: The guard uses PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7 even though the error string and project floor say 3.10. A bare python3 resolving to 3.7-3.9 would pass the numeric check while contradicting the message. Tighten the lower bound to 10 so predicate, message, and pyproject agree on a single minimum.

issues.description: test-install-scripts.yml prep steps add noisy 'dnf search python3.12' and unmotivated 'dnf update -y'.
issues.detail: The Amazon/Rocky prep now runs dnf update -y and dnf search python3.12 before install. search produces unused output and does not gate anything; update -y on every CI run slows the job and changes the test substrate without justification. Remove the search and justify or drop the update.

issues.description: conditions.py 'continue' branch lost its justifying comment about the 3.9 coverage quirk.
issues.detail: The previous multi-line comment explained why the else-branch existed and referenced coveragepy#1530. With 3.9 gone, either the branch is now covered (delete the pragma/branch) or it remains structurally needed (add a one-line 'unhandled condition type; skip' comment). Unexplained control flow in an if/elif chain should not ship.

synthesis.summary: The mechanical removal of Python 3.9 support is largely correct: version pins, CI matrices, dataclass kw_only branches, and the itertools.pairwise swap are consistently raised. But the cleanup is half-finished. Compatibility scaffolding (default_raise, '< 3.10' comments, the conditions.py pragma rationale) remains even though its precondition is gone, and ruff.toml suppresses UP007/UP035/UP045 with a bare TODO, contradicting the PR's stated Union/Optional modernization. install.sh's numeric guard still permits 3.7-3.9 while the error message claims >= 3.10, and CI prep steps gained unjustified dnf noise. Finish removing the 3.9 fingerprints before they ossify as folklore.
